snippet.title: Sledding Game - Early Access Release Date Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Sledding Game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3438850 

Sledding Game is a multiplayer hangout game where you race down hills, do cool tricks, and crash spectacularly with ridiculous ragdoll physics. Need a break? Hit the chalet to chill, drink cocoa, build snowmen, go ice fishing and more! With proximity chat, character and sled customization, and tons of minigames, it’s all about cozy yet chaotic fun with friends. Sledding Game launches into Early Access on April 30th!

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/iii-initiative.bsky.social 
Bilibili: https://space.bilibili.com/3546638813497663 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
